profile.headline: SWE
profile.summary: Well rounded for SDLC from design, build, test and deployment with automation in each steps.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Rejoined NetApp as a Software Engineer, specializing in the Cloud Volume Service (CVS) SaaS on Kubernetes.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate REST API server functionalities into client applications.
Led the GenAI initiative within the team to enhance developer productivity while developing core business features.

positions.title: SW consultant
positions.description:
Implement best practices in SDLC like code formatting, static type annotation, unit test, integration tests, code coverage, packaging and deployment written in Python deployed in Linux.
Standardize and architect Linux service, signal handling, multi-process communication.
Consult other various SW development.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Improving Developer Productivity in CI, IDE, build tools.
- Automate OS release process and generate audit report in AWS Lambda function.
- Design and implement Merge Queue to automate merge process in github.com.
- Improved build performance (20% reduction in 95 percentile) and build failure (10%
success rate increase) by gathering and analyzing build metrics and implementing based on analysis.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · GitHub · DevOps · GitFlow · MLOps · Docker Products · Terraform · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Improve build, build performance, developer happiness, developer productivity with metrics, survey, interviews.
Debug/analyze gradle performance by comparing builds.
Use Google Docs/Wiki for technical proposals and slack/email to communicate LA/GA.

AI100, AI200 training.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead design & develop Cloud Backup as a Service written in golang from the ground up with unit test, functional test, CI and code coverage.
Deploy the service with Docker image in Kubernetes using helm charts.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead design & develop new device management platform from the ground with unit test, functional test, CI and code coverage.
Develop AltaVault Cloud Backup software running on Linux.
Design & develop Snwoball integration, VLAN tagging, redesign VIF.

positions.title: Sr. SW Engineer for Mobile/Server Testing/Automation.
positions.description: Design and develop automation framework for iOS, Android client and REST API.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop & Design PIC(Preview, Impose, Compose) using wxWidgets to support Windows & OS X.
Work with QA and PO with Scrum meeting and Agile method.
Develop AUTL(Automated UI Testing Library), the core of UI Automation tool and python framework for CWS5 testing.
Develop test cases using CppUnit and Python UnitTest.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Actively redesign and add new feature to EFI Imposition Software.
Develop PIC, OneFlow, FRS, ScanBuilder.
Develop test cases using CppUnit.
